samples.question: The compact cassette contains a reference badge R and candidate badges A and B. Each badge is a 4x4 dark-cell mosaic with equal total ink. Reflect each candidate mosaic left-to-right. For each badge, count dark cells in its four 2x2 quadrants in clockwise order starting at upper-left. Choose the candidate whose transformed four-count sequence equals R, then answer with that candidate's seal color.
